verdict.rationale: Qodo's own docs describe several pieces of this story: a PR-history mechanism that learns from the team's pull request activity, Relevance scoring based on how the team handled similar findings in past PRs, Rule Miner that generates rules from PR history, and a centralized rule system for enforcing standards. Together these cover building conventions from past review decisions and applying them to future reviews. The evidence is short doc snippets only, so how persistent and deep this memory is remains unproven. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how learned memory and mined rules persist and are automatically applied to new PRs, any independent or hands-on corroboration that the learning works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer builds a persistent memory of my team's conventions and past review decisions and applies it to future PRs
